newsitem.title: USA: CCC seeks up to 35,000 T U.S. wheat for Eritrea.
newsitem.headline: CCC seeks up to 35,000 T U.S. wheat for Eritrea.

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corp said it is retendering for up to 35,000 tonnes U.S. No.2 or better hard red winter, soft white or soft red winter wheat under its export donation program to Eritrea.
On September 27 the CCC, which is part of the U.S. Department of Agriculture, declined to buy the wheat.
Shipment was slated for October 30-November 25. Offers must be due by October 15.
The wheat must be tested for vomitoxin and originate in U.S. areas where Karnal Bunt (Tilletia Indica) is not known to occur.
